title: Mastering Sec 51, 56(2)(ix) & Sec 54 Capital Gains Exemption
subject: DT
provision_raw:
Section 54 & Section 51: Capital Gains Exemption & Forfeiture of Advance Money
Provision / Section	Statutory Trigger / Condition	Tax Treatment / Formula	Judicial Benchmark / Landmark Rule
Section 51	Advance money forfeited prior to 01/04/2014	Reduced from Cost of Acquisition	Reduces base cost before applying indexation
Section 56(2)(ix)	Advance money forfeited on or after 01/04/2014	Taxed under Income from Other Sources	Does NOT reduce Cost of Acquisition
Section 54	Purchase/construction of residential house	Exempt = Lower of Capital Gain or Cost of New Asset	Purchase: 1 yr before or 2 yrs after transfer; Construction: 3 yrs after
Section 54 Proviso	Capital Gain ≤ ₹ 2 Crore (Once-in-a-lifetime)	Exemption available for Two residential houses in India	Aggregate investment across both houses is eligible
story_summary: Mr. Rajesh sells his residential house in Ernakulam after forfeiting advance money in two different tax regimes (2011 and 2016). He calculates his net capital gain of ₹1.5 Crores and strategically reinvests it into two smaller residential properties under the Section 54 Proviso once-in-a-lifetime rule.

slides.slide_title: Pre-2014 Advance Forfeiture: Reduction from Cost (Sec 51)
slides.scene_purpose: Explain how advance money forfeited prior to 01/04/2014 reduces the original Cost of Acquisition (COA).
slides.dialogue_manglish: Friends, look at Rajesh's case. 2005-ൽ Rajesh 10 Lakhs-ന് buy ചെയ്ത residential house 2011-ൽ sell ചെയ്യാൻ ഒരു deal ആക്കി. Buyer deal cancel ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ 2 Lakhs advance money forfeit ചെയ്തു. Section 51 പ്രകാരം 01/04/2014-ന് മുമ്പ് forfeit ചെയ്ത advance money, property-യുടെ original Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് deduct ചെയ്യണം. So base cost ₹10L ൽ നിന്ന് ₹2L കുറഞ്ഞ് net ₹8L ആയി മാറും!

slots.title: Sec 51: Pre-2014 Advance Money Forfeiture
slots.note: Under Sec 51, advance forfeited prior to 01-04-2014 is deducted from COA before indexation.

slides.slide_title: Post-2014 Advance Forfeiture: Taxed as IFOS (Sec 56(2)(ix))
slides.scene_purpose: Demonstrate that advance money forfeited on/after 01/04/2014 does not touch COA and is taxed under Income from Other Sources.
slides.dialogue_manglish: 2016-ൽ Rajesh വീണ്ടും 5 Lakhs advance received & forfeited. Dynamic change in tax law! Section 56(2)(ix) പ്രകാരം 01/04/2014-ന് ശേഷം forfeit ചെയ്യുന്ന advance money 'Income from Other Sources'-ൽ അതാത് വർഷം fully taxable ആണ്. It will NEVER reduce the Cost of Acquisition!

slots.title: Sec 56(2)(ix): Post-2014 Advance Forfeiture
slots.statement: Advance money forfeited on or after 01/04/2014 is directly taxable under Income from Other Sources.
slots.support_line: Taxed in the year of forfeiture; Cost of Acquisition remains completely unaffected.

slides.slide_title: Net Long Term Capital Gain (LTCG) Calculation
slides.scene_purpose: Show the calculation of net Capital Gain after applying indexed cost to the adjusted base cost.
slides.dialogue_manglish: 2023-ൽ Rajesh ഈ house ₹2.10 Crores-ന് sell ചെയ്യുന്നു. Adjusted base cost ₹8 Lakhs index ചെയ്ത് Deduct ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ Net Long-Term Capital Gain ₹1.50 Crores ലഭിക്കുന്നു. Let's see how Rajesh can save tax on this ₹1.50 Crores!

slots.title: Net LTCG Computation for FY 2023-24
slots.note: Net LTCG comes out to ₹ 1.50 Crores.

slides.slide_title: Section 54 Proviso: Qualification Gate for 2 Houses
slides.scene_purpose: Check whether Rajesh meets the criteria for investing in TWO residential houses under the Sec 54 Proviso.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Section 54 പ്രകാരം normally 1 residential house-ൽ മാത്രമേ exemption കിട്ടു. But look at the Special Proviso! Capital gain ₹2 Crores-ൽ താഴെ ആണെങ്കിൽ, Assessee-ക്ക് once-in-a-lifetime offer ആയി INDIA-യിൽ 2 residential houses buy ചെയ്യാം. Here LTCG ₹1.5 Cr ≤ ₹2 Cr, test passed!

slots.title: Sec 54 Proviso: Two Residential Houses Benefit Gate

conditions.text: Transfer of Long Term Residential House Property
Net Capital Gain does NOT exceed ₹ 2 Crores (Actual: ₹ 1.5 Cr)
Option exercised ONCE in a lifetime

slots.note: All conditions satisfied! Rajesh can invest in two residential properties in India.

slides.scene_purpose: Demonstrate the aggregation of investment across two new residential houses.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Rajesh 2 years-നുള്ളിൽ Kakkanad-ൽ ₹80 Lakhs-ൻ്റെ ഒരു apartment-ഉം Aluva-യിൽ ₹60 Lakhs-ൻ്റെ ഒരു house-ഉം buy ചെയ്തു. Sec 54 Proviso അനുവദിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഈ രണ്ട് residential houses-ൻ്റെയും total investment ₹1.40 Crores എലിജിബിൾ reinvestment ആയി മാറും!

slots.title: Consolidation of Reinvestment in Two Houses
slots.merged_label: Total Reinvestment Eligible for Sec 54 (₹ 1.40 Cr)
slots.note: Aggregate cost of both residential houses purchased within 2 years.

slides.scene_purpose: Compare Capital Gain vs Cost of New Assets to calculate final exemption (Lower of the two).
slides.dialogue_manglish: Final Exemption benchmark! Sec 54 പ്രകാരം Exemption = Lower of Capital Gain (₹1.50 Cr) OR Cost of New Assets (₹1.40 Cr). So Rajesh-ന് ₹1.40 Crores full exemption ആയി ലഭിക്കും! Remaining Taxable LTCG represents just ₹10 Lakhs. Brilliant tax planning!

slots.title: Sec 54 Final Exemption Benchmark
slots.note: Exemption allowed is LOWER of Capital Gain or Investment in New Assets. Final Taxable LTCG = ₹ 10 Lakhs.
